emprendeamos-2022.title: Emprendeamos 2022 Winner
emprendeamos-2022.subtitle: Award
emprendeamos-2022.summary: Winner of the Emprendamos program, focused on launching a real venture.
emprendeamos-2022.context: Emprendeamos was an ideathon promoted by Ing. Herminio Arrieta Technical School, Ledesma SAAI, Endeavor, and Logos. The goal was not just slides: teams had to move toward a real venture with validation and execution.

developer.title: My role as developer
bullets: Designed and built the technical solution with the team.
Defined the initial architecture, prototypes, and functional deliverables for the final demo.
Worked in short iterations focused on feasibility and jury presentation.

emprendeamos-2022.outcome: We won the 2022 edition. It was one of my first experiences shipping something real under deadline, pitch, and concrete user pressure.

seo.title: Emprendeamos 2022 | Agustín Juárez
seo.description: Emprendeamos 2022 winner: real ideathon with product development, pitch, and startup execution.

sub0-2025.title: Sub0 Polkadot 2025 Participant
sub0-2025.subtitle: Hackathon
sub0-2025.summary: Participated in the Sub0 hackathon with other SaltaDev members.
sub0-2025.context: Sub0 is a Polkadot ecosystem hackathon. We joined from SaltaDev with little time to research, prototype, and present a Web3-oriented solution.

developer.title: My role as developer
bullets: Contributed to the project's backend and grant analysis logic.
Collaborated on the project's frontend development.
Worked in an in-person team with clear task divisions and frequent merges.

sub0-2025.outcome: We delivered Leivy, a system for analyzing project grants and subsidies on Polkadot.

seo.title: Sub0 Polkadot 2025 | Agustín Juárez
seo.description: Sub0 Polkadot 2025 with SaltaDev. Development of Leivy, a grant and subsidy analysis system for Polkadot.

aleph-2026.title: Aleph Hackathon Participant
aleph-2026.subtitle: Hackathon
aleph-2026.summary: Participated in the Aleph hackathon building Ink with a teammate.
aleph-2026.context: Aleph was a Web3 and smart contract hackathon. The challenge was to build a functional solution in little time, from idea to a deployed, presentable demo.

developer.title: My role as developer
bullets: Built the logic behind Ink: smart contract analysis, risk scoring, and IPFS integration.
Worked in a pair with a teammate: they handled the frontend while I owned the backend and analysis engine.
Implemented the API and evaluation criteria that feed each contract's risk score.

aleph-2026.outcome: We delivered Ink, a smart contract risk detector with AI-assisted analysis. It was deployed as a public demo and connects to my Web3 project portfolio.

seo.title: Aleph Hackathon | Agustín Juárez
seo.description: Aleph hackathon participation. Development of Ink: AI-powered smart contract risk detector. Backend, analysis logic, and IPFS integration.

vendimiatech-2026.title: 2nd Place VendimiaTech 2026
vendimiatech-2026.subtitle: Hackathon
vendimiatech-2026.summary: Second place at VendimiaTech 2026 with a tokenized vineyard certification project.
vendimiatech-2026.context: VendimiaTech took place in Mendoza with Salta as a satellite hub. The challenge was a 48-hour hackathon using blockchain and Web3 technologies.

developer.title: My role as developer
bullets: Built VitisTrust: an oracle that monitors vineyards via satellite and issues certification.
Integrated React, Python, Groq, and blockchain layers (Hedera / Rootstock).
Implemented an end-to-end flow from data ingestion to verifiable demo response.

organizer.title: My role as organizer
bullets: Coordinated Salta's satellite node participation with SaltaDev.
Helped align teams, schedules, and local logistics for the hackathon.
Facilitated communication between participants and mentors during the event.

vendimiatech-2026.outcome: I placed second. VitisTrust was deployed as a public demo and connects directly to my Web3/agtech project portfolio.

seo.title: VendimiaTech 2026 | Agustín Juárez
seo.description: 2nd place at VendimiaTech 2026. VitisTrust: tokenized vineyard certification. Developer and organizer roles at Salta hub.
